svg.title: System architecture of Rishta Safe
svg.desc: Six kinds of people reach a web app; every call goes to one API inside a server trust boundary, then a composition layer, six domain packages and versioned data. Employers and insurers are refused. No language model runs at run time.
svg.text: only released text and numbers return
role check, disclosure policy and correlation id on every call
Composition layer: the only code that calls across the packages
simulated adapters only, no real integration
Outside systems, simulated and labelled: Emirates Health Services, Malaffi, Emirati Genome Programme,
DoH and DHA forms, the national genomic database (a statutory recipient, Federal Decree-Law 49/2023 Art. 26(2)).
built and run in the prototype
